title: JustVanish
body:
# 👻 JustVanish
- **JustVanish** is a lightweight and simple vanish plugin designed for Minecraft servers running 1.21+.
- It allows staff members or players with permission to toggle their visibility with a single command.
## ✨ Features:
- Toggle vanish mode with /vanish
- Reload configuration with /vanish reload
- Fully customizable messages (join/leave, vanish on/off, etc.)
- Configurable prefix for all plugin messages
- Permission system for controlled access
- Optimized, no unnecessary bloat
- Supports RGB and Gradients
## ⚒️ Commands:
- **/vanish** » Toggle vanish on/off
- **/vanish help** » Help menu
- **/vanish reload** » Reloads the plugin configuration
## 🔐 Permissions:
- **justvanish.use** » Allows use of /vanish (default: OP)
- **justvanish.help** » Allows use of /vanish help (default: OP)
- **justvanish.reload** » Allows use of /vanish reload (default: OP)
## 💻 Open Source:
- Fully open-source.
